shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md; find .agents -type f | head -50

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ------; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo -----; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}'; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Text Flex Card Avatar ThemeProvider FormRow 2>&1 | head -80
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Text Flex Card Avatar FormRow 2>&1 | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build 2>/dev/null | head; D=build/esm/components; for c in Select Switch Checkbox TextInput Avatar Text; do echo "=== $c"; ls $D/$c | head -20; done; ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts Avatar/Avatar.d.ts; ls controls controls/TextInput; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; sed -n 1,80p Select/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && sed -n 80,140p components/Select/types.d.ts; grep -n "ControlProps\b" -A22 components/types.d.ts | head -50; cat components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -60; ls components/lab; ls hooks | tr '\n' ' '; cat hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n "errorMessage\|validationState\|error?" components/controls/types.d.ts; grep -n "Text\b.*variant\|TextProps" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head; ls components/layout; cat components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Avatar/AvatarImage/*.d.ts | head -30; cat Avatar/types/common.d.ts; cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "variant" Text/text/*.d.ts | head -5; cat layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -30; cat layout/Flex/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; grep -n "hidden\|style\|type" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.js | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; rm -rf dist; git status --short
